section.question: Implement Order#apply_discount(code). Look the code up with DiscountCode.find_by(code: code). Return false and leave total_cents unchanged when the code is unknown or expired (expires_at in the past). Otherwise reduce total_cents by the code's percent_off, never below zero, save the order, and return true.
section.starter_code:
class Order < ApplicationRecord
  def apply_discount(code)
    # TODO
  end
end

answers.complete:
def apply_discount(code)
  discount = DiscountCode.find_by(code: code)
  return false if discount.nil? || discount.expires_at.past?

  reduction = (total_cents * discount.percent_off / 100.0).round
  self.total_cents = [total_cents - reduction, 0].max
  save!
  true
end
